::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 20th [1883?]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Miss Sarah Jardine-Willoughby[^1]
:::

My dear [Miss Bussell](people/person_232.qmd)

Many thanks for your [portrait](other_books/otherbook_958.qmd) which I like very much, & will try to put in.[^2]

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: A card with rounded corners, of the same type as
[^2]: Euphemia Bussell, ‘A Brief Memoir of the late Mrs Anne Elinor Prevost’ *MP* (April 1883) 380-4.
